Nadia, I posted the list in #strategic-pod. It has four tickets, each with its source. I only searched your three sources, so tickets that live only in the ticket system or in email may be missing.

- **#8841 (also written #PD-8841):** It appears in the 4/27, 5/4 and 9/30 digests and in a #strategic-pod message from Gideon on 7/1. The accounts of it don't agree. Gideon said it was closed on 7/1, but the 9/30 digest has it open again. The sites also differ: Allentown in the earlier mentions, Newark on 9/30. It may be a reopen or a reused number, so check the ticket system before telling Mateo.
- **INC-4821:** The Hartford status-page access issue, from #inc-vtg-hartford on 8/3.
- **VT-55120:** The root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage, from #inc-vtg-hartford on 10/14. I haven't opened it myself.
- **#PD-4418:** A Carrier_Dwell_Summary export problem, from the 9/15/2025 digest. That digest only says "the account Nadia runs", and you also run a medical account. I can't confirm it belongs to Vantorre Group.

I left out Vantorre Mobility's #4812 and Quillfeather's #PD-4402. Two digest items mention duplicate arrival entries, on 12/1/2025 and 5/3/2026. Neither gives a ticket number, and the 12/1 one is under Mobility.
